capabilities: Export notes to PDF from a ribbon icon or the command palette
Preview page layout with real paper proportions, simulated margins and page-break marks
Customize colors, fonts, covers and footers through a schema-driven settings form
Create custom theme packs as folders with theme.json and theme.css that can extend built-in packs
Render Mermaid diagrams as vector graphics using the format's palette
extras: Desktop-only: the plugin relies on Electron's printToPDF, unavailable on mobile. Full theme format and rationale documentation lives in separate files (docs/theme-format.md, docs/format-rationale.md). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The optional Chrome dependency applies only to the standalone Go CLI, not the plugin itself.
motivation: The author built it because no existing Obsidian PDF exporter has a portable format — a folder with a stylesheet and JSON that can be committed, reviewed in pull requests, and shared.
problem: Existing PDF exporters offer no portable format, so teams cannot keep export styling in git or guarantee colleagues produce identical documents.

relations.evidence: The same packs the Pressmark CLI uses, so terminal and vault produce identical documents.
only Obsidian resolves wikilinks, embeds, callouts and Dataview blocks

summary: PDF exporter that styles notes through versionable theme packs shared with a companion command-line tool for identical output.
